async function plan(input: AnswerInput, memories: Recalled[]) {
  const started = performance.now()
  const history = input.history
    .slice(-6)
    .map((m) => `${m.role === "user" ? "User" : "Assistant"}: ${m.text.slice(0, 1200)}`)
    .join("\n")
  const { result, choice } = await withFallback("planner", input.tracer, "plan", (c) =>
    generateText({
      model: model(c),
      providerOptions: reasoning(c),
      output: Output.object({ schema: PlanSchema }),
      instructions:
        "You are the Planner in a research assistant that answers from the user's own library of documents and recordings. If the latest question already stands alone, keep the user's own words as `standalone`; otherwise rewrite it minimally using the conversation. Then write search queries for the library: keywords and phrases its passages would contain, not questions.",
      prompt: `${memoryBlock(memories)}${history ? `Conversation so far:\n${history}\n\n` : ""}Latest question: ${input.question}`,
      abortSignal: input.abortSignal,
    }),
  )
  const out = result.output
  input.tracer.log({
    agent: "planner",
    step: "plan",
    action: "planned",
    model: choice.id,
    latencyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
    tokens: { input: result.usage.inputTokens, output: result.usage.outputTokens },
    detail: out,
  })
  return { ...out, model: choice.id }
}

async function searchLibrary(
  ownerId: string,
  queries: string[],
  scope: Scope = {},
  limit = 16,
  /** Check my draft and search citation look only at sources: a note never supports a note. */
  options: { excludeNotes?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<{ candidates: Candidate[]; scopedFiles: number | null }> {
  // Mine as always; in a shared space, exactly the files its members may read (access.ts).
  const reach = await resolveReach(ownerId, scope)
  const files = reach.fileIds
  if (files && !files.length) return { candidates: [], scopedFiles: 0 }
  const notNotes = options.excludeNotes ? sql`and f.kind <> 'note'` : sql``
  const inReach = reachSql(reach, "p")

  const vectors = await embedQueries(queries)
  const lists = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Filters run after the HNSW scan; iterative scans keep looking until enough rows pass them.
    await tx.execute(sql`set local hnsw.ef_search = 100`)
    await tx.execute(sql`set local hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order`)
    const runs = []
    for (const [i, query] of queries.entries()) {
      const vector = `[${vectors[i]?.join(",")}]`
      runs.push(
        tx.execute<{ id: string; sim: number }>(sql`
          select p.id, 1 - (p.embedding <=> ${vector}::vector) as sim
          from passages p join files f on f.id = p.file_id
          where ${inReach} and f.deleted_at is null and f.status = 'ready' ${notNotes}
            and p.embedding is not null
          order by p.embedding <=> ${vector}::vector
          limit ${PER_LIST}
        `),
        tx.execute<{ id: string; sim: number }>(sql`
          select p.id, 0 as sim
          from passages p join files f on f.id = p.file_id,
            websearch_to_tsquery('english', ${query}) q
          where ${inReach} and f.deleted_at is null and f.status = 'ready' ${notNotes}
            and p.tsv @@ q
          order by ts_rank_cd(p.tsv, q) desc
          limit ${PER_LIST}

 * One window → its items (plan F27): the Tutor drafts them; code checks every quote, sentence

  w: StudyWindow,
  options: {

/**
 * Many pieces in one request (the endpoint takes an array and answers one result per piece), so
 * a long article is one call, not a burst. One retry; `checked` is false only if both fail.
 */
export async function moderateAll(pieces: string[]): Promise<Moderation> {
  const input = pieces.filter((p) => p.trim())
  if (!input.length) return { flagged: false, categories: [], checked: true }
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    if (attempt) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, RETRY_AFTER_MS))
    try {
      const res = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          authorization: `Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}`,
          "content-type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ model: PUBLIC.moderationModel, input }),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS),
      })
      if (!res.ok) continue
      const body = (await res.json()) as {
        results?: { flagged: boolean; categories: Record<string, boolean> }[]
      }
      const results = body.results ?? []
      if (results.length !== input.length) continue
      return {
        flagged: results.some((r) => r.flagged),
        categories: [
          ...new Set(
            results.flatMap((r) =>
              Object.entries(r.categories ?? {})
                .filter(([, on]) => on)
                .map(([name]) => name),
            ),
          ),
        ],
        checked: true,
      }
    } catch {}
  }

/**
 * Runs a call on the role's model, and once more on its fallback if that fails (an outage, a
 * malformed reply), logging the switch. Stopped runs and an empty account don't fall back.
 */
export async function withFallback<T>(
  role: Role,
  agent: TraceEvent["agent"],
  tracer: Tracer | undefined,
  step: string,
  fn: (choice: ModelChoice) => Promise<T>,
): Promise<{ result: T; choice: ModelChoice }> {
  const { primary, fallback } = MODELS[role]
  try {
    return { result: await fn(primary), choice: primary }
  } catch (error) {
    if (noFallback(error)) throw error
    tracer?.log({
      agent,
      step,
      action: "escalated_to_fallback",
      model: fallback.id,
      detail: { reason: (error as Error).message.slice(0, 300) },
    })
    return { result: await fn(fallback), choice: fallback }
  }
}

/** Query vectors from the cache, the missing ones in a single embedding request. */
export async function embedQueries(texts: string[]): Promise<number[][]> {
  const hashes = texts.map(cacheKey)
  const hits = await db
    .select({ hash: embeddingCache.hash, embedding: embeddingCache.embedding })
    .from(embeddingCache)
    .where(inArray(embeddingCache.hash, hashes))
  const cached = new Map(hits.map((h) => [h.hash, h.embedding]))
  const missing = texts.filter((_, i) => !cached.has(hashes[i] as string))
  if (missing.length) {
    const { embeddings } = await embedMany({
      model: openai.embedding(EMBEDDING_MODEL),
      values: missing,
    })
    const fresh = missing.map((text, i) => ({
      hash: cacheKey(text),
      embedding: embeddings[i] as number[],
    }))
    await db.insert(embeddingCache).values(fresh).onConflictDoNothing()
    for (const f of fresh) cached.set(f.hash, f.embedding)
  }
  return hashes.map((h) => cached.get(h) as number[])
}
